text:
[LCRS.3.1] **Every call carries a correlation.** It is the value of the
call's `as` binding ([LRST.1.1]), or, for a call with no `as` or whose `as`
evaluates to `""` ([LRST.1.2]), the value generated for each firing
([LCCO.3.4]). A correlation is a `String`,
never `null` and never empty, whatever the call's service. It threads through
to every answer the call receives: its response fact ([LCRS.4.3.1]) and its
`CallError` ([LCRS.3.2]).

idris.name: Lcrs_6_2_1__site
idris.note: Every call has a correlation: the site's `as`, the lowering's literal. LESS than the clause: a computed `as` and the generated form are outside.

idris.name: lcrs_6_2_1__corr_c1
idris.note: A fixture. An author's `as`; the generated form is outside.

tla.name: lcrs_3_1__corr
tla.note: The correlation of a call's request, as the engine compares it: an author's `as` is one value every firing of the call shares, and a generated correlation is unique to its firing, so it is the request's own number. Every call has one, and every answer carries its request's. Modelled as a value the sweeps compare, never as a String; that it is never null or empty is the clause's and not drawn.
